description: Shop settings shared by the game, the baristas, and the k6 rush. Times are in shop seconds; the real cluster runs timeScale times faster.

lesson-1-1.description: A steady morning: 20 walk-ins over 20 minutes.

lesson-1-2.description: A busier morning: 24 walk-ins over 20 minutes.

lesson-2.description: The 8:05 rush: 50 walk-ins over ten minutes.

lesson-3-1.description: The app launches: 36 customers over 15 minutes, 40% ordering in the app.

lesson-3-2.description: A long, steady rush: 54 customers over 30 minutes, 35% ordering in the app.

lesson-4-1.description: A latte-heavy morning: 28 walk-ins over 15 minutes, 70% lattes.

lesson-4-2.description: A quiet half hour: 16 walk-ins over 30 minutes, 70% lattes.

lesson-4-3.description: The app rush: 52 customers over 30 minutes, 35% ordering in the app, 70% lattes.

batch.description: Steaming milk for two lattes at once. In the real shop one latte takes 2 minutes and two batched take 2.5, so a batch takes 1.25x one drink.
